title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. Grothendieck works with a 'configuration' M: a set of abstract figures X carrying two relations, an order ≤ ('is a face of') and a separation/disjointness relation X|∘|Y, subject to axioms M_θ1–M_θ4. A homomorphism M → Figures(P) into the figures of a set P is a 'realization'. The previous page proves a theorem: such homomorphisms correspond one-to-one to maps X ↦ |X| ⊂ P satisfying conditions (i)–(iv) of p. 59. One of these is (iv): |Z| = ⋃_{Z'≤Z} |Z'|°, where |Z|° is the 'open cell' or interior part of |Z|. Another, via (ii), is that X|∘|Y implies |X|°∩|Y|°=∅.

This page.
1. Name. Such a map is called a 'vraie fonction support externe' with values in 𝓕(P).
2. Normalized. The function is 'normalisée' if two conditions hold:
   (a) P = |M|, i.e. the |X| cover P;
   (b) the |X| separate the points of P.
   He notes that (b) is equivalent to the open parts |X|° separating points. Given (iv) and the disjointness of |X|° from lower faces, the |X|° then partition P. So a point is determined by the unique X with p ∈ |X|°, equivalently by the set of X whose support contains it.
3. Faithful. The function is 'fidèle' if, besides (ii) and (iii), the converse holds: for all X, Y ∈ M, X|∘|Y ⟺ |X|°∩|Y|°=∅. In other words, the set-theoretic realization reflects the abstract separation relation exactly.
4. NB on normalization. Replacing P by a partition (quotient) of |M| reduces any support function to a normalized one: collapse points not separated by the |X|.
5. Left-margin terminology. A configuration is called 'géométrique' (it has a 'réalisation ensembliste') when its relations are 'ensemblistes', i.e. f(X)∩f(Y)=∅ ⇒ X∘Y.
6. Programmatic remark. In all the examples he has touched (set-theoretic contexts, topology, tame/'modérée' topology), faithful support functions always exist. Hence the desirable properties that follow from the existence of such a function could simply be posed as axioms.
7. Corrections and exceptions. The next page names the exception: geometries defined by a distance function, where separation is 'distance > ε'. A diagonal bottom-margin note (dated 2.7) corrects the claim as inexact for certain topological cases, and seems to say that only a weaker statement about φ(X) holds.

Purpose. The page serves Grothendieck's axiomatic 'analysis situs'. Abstract incidence/separation structures on 'figures' are to be axiomatized so that they are representable by actual subsets of a point set. Existence of a faithful normalized realization is a representation theorem, which he proposes to adopt as an axiom.
errors: The claim 'there always exist faithful support functions' in topological contexts is retracted by Grothendieck himself in the dated (2.7) diagonal margin note ('C'est inexact pour ... topologiques'); the main text is thus superseded.

The equivalence 'the |X| separate points ⟺ the |X|° separate points' is not automatic. It needs condition (iv) and the disjointness |X|°∩|Z|°=∅ for Z<X, both established on the previous page; with these it is correct.

ideas.what: Support function X ↦ |X| ⊂ P realizing an abstract configuration (poset of figures with disjointness relation) as subsets of a point set, with open parts |X|° and closure |X| = union of open parts of faces
ideas.modern_name: set-theoretic/topological realization of a face poset or stratification; representation of a contact/separation structure by sets
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical (regular CW complexes / face posets; Stone-type representation theory)
ideas.where_published: Analysis situs notes unpublished; Esquisse d'un programme only sketches tame topology

ideas.what: Normalized realization: supports cover P and separate points, equivalently the open parts partition P; any realization can be reduced to a normalized one by quotienting
ideas.modern_name: Kolmogorov (T0) quotient / points as 'types' of a stratification

ideas.what: Faithful realization: abstract separation X|∘|Y holds iff the open parts are disjoint; proposal to take existence of faithful realizations as an axiom of the theory
ideas.modern_name: representation theorem for contact/overlap algebras (mereotopology, region-based theories of space)
ideas.usually_credited_to: de Laguna, Whitehead; Clarke; Randell–Cui–Cohn (RCC, 1992); Düntsch–Winter (2005); Dimov–Vakarelov

missed.claim: Grothendieck's configurations are point-free structures of figures with an order and a disjointness relation. Their faithful set realizations, where disjointness is reflected exactly, are the same problem studied in mereotopology / region connection calculus, where representation theorems realize contact algebras by regular closed sets. He arrives independently, in 1986, at the idea of axiomatizing geometry on figures and making representability by points an axiom or theorem. He also flags that tame topology admits such representations while metric (ε-distance) geometries do not.
missed.quote: Elle est dite fidèle si ... ∀X,Y∈M, X|∘|Y ⟺ |X|°∩|Y|°=∅ ... il existe toujours des fonctions support fidèles
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This links his tame-topology programme to the point-free/region-based spatial-reasoning literature, which has not drawn on Grothendieck. The tame-topology examples suggest o-minimal structures as a natural class of faithfully representable contact structures.

deep.surprise_reason: These are mostly definitions (normalized, faithful realization) in an unpublished axiomatic programme. They are interesting as evidence of his point-free approach to tame topology, but the content is elementary, and the main existence claim is retracted in his own margin.
transcription_corrections: Page number at top is '62' (archive folio 71); the transcription's page labels are consistent with this.
Line 1 reads 'vraie fonction support externe (à valeurs dans 𝓕(P))'.
NB likely reads: 'en remplaçant P [circled X with arrow to P] par une partition de |M|, on se ramène au cas d'une fonction support normalisée'.
Faithfulness condition: the relation symbol is X|∘|Y (separation), not X∘Y.

Main text after 'il existe toujours* des fonctions support fidèles' continues roughly 'sur des ens. ... assez petits / commodes. D'où les propriétés souhaitables qui seraient conséquences ...'; 'Donc' may be 'D'où'. Uncertain.

Bottom-left diagonal margin begins '2.7. C'est inexact dans le cas des [pseudo?]géométries topologiques ...'. It is a dated (2 July) correction of the starred claim and mentions φ(X) ⊂ ...; partly illegible.
